Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Amsterdam or London | Reports to Senior Director, Product

The opportunity

Checkout.com helps businesses thrive in the digital economy by making payments work better. Fraud is central to that mission: we need to protect our merchants and Checkout without blocking good customers or adding unnecessary friction.

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the fraud domain across Payment Performance. You will own the strategy for building our fraud engine with real-time models, controls and decisioning capabilities that protect Checkout and the products built on top of it.

The ambition is to build a best-in-class fraud platform: one that performs at the highest level, adapts as fraud changes and works equally well for merchants as it does to protect Checkout. Protecting Checkout from fraud has significant value for the overall payment performance,

This is a portfolio leadership role. You will lead several Product Managers, co-own the Fraud Data Science roadmap and work closely with Engineering, Analytics, Fraud Operations and Design. You will also spend time with some of the world’s most sophisticated merchants to understand their fraud challenges, prove value and shape what we build next.

What you’ll do

Set the fraud strategy

  • Create one product vision and roadmap across merchant fraud products, real-time decisioning and Checkout-wide protection.

  • Decide where we need to close core gaps and where we can build differentiated capabilities that change the basis of competition.

  • Balance merchant fraud, Checkout losses, acceptance impact, FDP revenue and operational effort when setting priorities.

  • Define how our fraud capabilities should support Enterprise merchants, Platforms, SMBs and other Checkout products as their needs evolve.

Build a best-in-class fraud platform

  • Improve the performance, coverage and resilience of our real-time fraud decisioning.

  • Build products that let merchants choose the right level of control: configure their own protection, act on intelligent recommendations or delegate decisions to Autopilot.

  • Build a platform that enables our internal teams to investigate and respond to fraud trends and fraud attacks, then turn this into better protection for Checkout and our merchants

  • Strengthen how merchants monitor, explain and improve fraud decisions through better controls, recommendations, alerting and investigation experiences.

  • Expand protection against new fraud types using better data, specialized models and faster learning loops.

Shape Product and Data Science together

  • Co-own the Fraud Data Science roadmap and outcome metrics with the Data Science leader.

  • Ensure Product chooses the right problems, customer outcomes and trade-offs while Data Science owns methods, model quality and scientific rigor.

  • Connect model performance and platform investment to visible merchant and business outcomes.

  • Build the feedback loops between models, merchant products, analytics and operations that allow our protection to keep improving.

  • Guide investment toward capabilities that improve fraud performance at scale, not technical progress in isolation.

Grow the portfolio and its value

  • Own the product economics of the fraud portfolio, including value measurement, investment cases, adoption strategy and input into packaging and pricing.

  • Partner with teams across Checkout include Commercial and Product Marketing to turn complex fraud capabilities into a clear merchant proposition.

  • Build credible ways to demonstrate the value of our fraud products before and after launch.

  • Work with Risk Operations to define clear boundaries, handovers and feedback loops between automated transaction decisions and account-level operations.

Lead the team

  • Lead, coach and develop Product Managers across the fraud portfolio.

  • Give teams clear ownership, goals and decision rights while building a strong shared purpose.

  • Create an effective operating model across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Design and Fraud Operations.

  • Align senior stakeholders around evidence-based priorities, investment choices and trade-offs.

What success looks like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • United FDP, Autopilot, core fraud decisioning and Checkout protection behind one strategy, metric framework and roadmap.

  • Improved measurable fraud performance while managing the impact on acceptance, Checkout losses and operational effort.

  • Closed priority product gaps and made the merchant fraud experience more competitive and coherent.

  • Established a stronger joint operating model across Product, Data Science, Engineering and Fraud Operations.

  • Built a high-performing team of Product Managers with clear accountability across the fraud domain.

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • Deep experience building fraud or risk products in payments, fintech, commerce or another high-volume decisioning environment.

  • Strong understanding of fraud models, rules, controls and the trade-offs between fraud prevention, false positives and customer experience.

  • A track record of setting strategy and delivering outcomes across multiple related products or teams.

  • Proven success leading and developing Product Managers.

  • The ability to bring clarity and structure to complex, ambiguous problem spaces.

  • Strong quantitative judgment and experience using model performance, experimentation and financial analysis to make decisions.

  • Credibility with Engineering and Data Science teams building real-time, ML-powered products.

  • Commercial judgment and the ability to connect technical capabilities to customer value, adoption and sustainable business outcomes.

  • Clear, persuasive communication with merchants, teams and senior executives.

We care more about the scope of the problems you have solved and the outcomes you have delivered than a fixed number of years in a particular title.

Valuable, but not required

  • Experience building adaptive or automated fraud products such as dynamic strategies or recommendations.

  • Knowledge of fraud operations, investigations, disputes and the handoffs between automated and human decisions.

  • Experience supporting multiple merchant segments, platforms or embedded payment products.

  • Experience shaping packaging, pricing or value-based commercial models for fraud products.

How we work

This role is based in Amsterdam or London and follows Checkout.com’s hybrid working model.

You will report to the Senior Director, Product and work across Product, Technology, Data, Risk and Commercial within the Payment Performance pillar.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Position

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead delivery of complex carrier and partner integrations enabling Hiya products

This role is delivery-focused, highly cross-functional, and deeply technical. You will be the primary point of contact between Hiya and carriers and partners across EMEA, ensuring each integration is planned, executed, tracked, and delivered. .

You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Specialists, Customer Success, and external carrier technical teams to bring new product integrations to life.

This role is based in London with an expectation of 3 days/week in-office. Hiya is a global company, with meeting times optimized across timezones.

What You’ll Do

Program & Delivery Leadership

  • Own end-to-end delivery integrations, from kickoff through deployment.

  • Define and manage realistic project plans milestones, dependencies, and risk registers.

  • Run weekly internal and external technical planning meetings, maintain project tracking docs, and ensure all stakeholders are aligned.

  • Ensure carriers and partners deliver their components on time (e.g., solution design inputs, network connectivity, integration configuration, data elements, test dependencies and test results, and delivery artifacts and related sign-offs,).

Technical Leadership & Problem Solving

  • Bring technical fluency in REST APIs, AWS services, and SIP/telephony basics.

  • Collaborate with Solution Architect, Engineering and Product to clarify requirements, validate API data and plan delivery.

  • Manage completion of Hiya’s technical delivery tasks and delivery lifecycle gates.

  • Identify technical blockers early, escalate appropriately, and drive resolution across teams.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

  • Act as the trusted point of contact for carriers and partners, ensuring expectations, timelines, and responsibilities are clear.
    Manage cross-functional communication with Solution Architect, Engineering, Success, Product, and leadership.

  • Present clear, concise updates to both technical and non-technical audiences internally and externally.

  • Build strong partnerships through collaborative persistence, clarity, and a bias toward action.

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to improving delivery practices, templates, and tooling for repeatability across future delivery programs.

  • Contribute to tailoring delivery framework to align with emerging new product deliveries.

  • Identify gaps in process, communication, or documentation and proactively address them.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years in technical program management or complex technical project delivery (SaaS preferred).

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle basics, Jira for ticket management, and program management methodologies is required.

  • Experience leading integrations involving APIs, AWS, and complex technical data flows.

  • Background in telecom, carriers, SIP/telephony, or adjacent industries

  • Proven experience owning large implementations end-to-end, with hands-on involvement in requirements, risks, and stakeholder alignment.

  • Strong command of implementation tracking (project plans, dependencies, RAID logs).

  • AI fluency: hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate program work and reduce manual labor, such as planning, status reporting, risk analysis, and documentation, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential internal and external data.

These qualities reflect Hiya’s core values of Serving our customers, Doing rather than observing, Improving ourselves and our business, Owning and holding ourselves accountable for success, and Leading by showing up:

  • Serve our customers – You lead with empathy, always seeking to understand customer challenges and provide solutions that deliver real value.

  • Do rather than observe – You take initiative, move deals forward with urgency, and find creative ways to overcome obstacles.

  • Improve yourself and our business – You embrace feedback, refine your craft, and seek opportunities to make our sales process and customer experience even better.

  • Own and hold yourself accountable for success – You take responsibility for your results, celebrate wins, and learn from setbacks without excuses.

  • Lead by showing up – You bring a clear point of view, engage in open and respectful discussion, and commit fully to team decisions that move Hiya forward.

The requirements listed in the job descriptions are guidelines. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable we would still love to hear from you.

More Details

  • Start Date: Immediately

  • Status: Full-time

  • Type: Hybrid

  • Location: London, UK

  • Travel Requirements: Some

  • Department: Business Development

  • Reports to: Head of Global Delivery Programs

Benefits

  • 25 holiday plus bank holidays

  • Opt in salary sacrifice pension scheme (company full 4% of basic salary contribution)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Private medical insurance through Vitality (including dental & vision)

  • Employer-paid life insurance 2x base salary

  • Donation Matching for a charity of your choice (up to $1,000/ year)

  • WFH equipment stipend

  • $1,000/year in Professional Development funds

  • Lunch provided on in- office days

This position is based in London, UK. Office post code: W1F 8WE

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


⭐ Mission

Shape how Qonto connects to the rest of its customers' world by building the Public API strategy: a reliable, consistent API that powers integrations, partners, MCP and Qonto Embed, and turns connectivity into a growth engine for our all-in-one and upmarket ambitions. You will report to Fanny, who leads Qonto Connect, and you will own the product and governance framework that every Qonto team builds on.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As Product Manager, Public API, you will:

  • Strategic ownership: Define the Public API strategy and roadmap for a product that already powers our integrations, MCP and Qonto Embed, and decide where to take it next.
  • Meaningful, high-stakes impact: Make the API a reliable foundation for connectivity, helping Connect grow for our active customers.
  • Platform thinking: Define a shared framework so that every Qonto team can build and expose its endpoints consistently, and partners can self-serve.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with PMs and engineering managers across Qonto to align on priorities and get API needs onto their roadmaps.

🤔 What you can expect

  • Market context: The Public API is no longer just integrations. It now also powers MCP and Qonto Embed, so complexity grows fast and we need one person fully focused on its strategy.
  • Team: You join the Connect team of 3 PMs (marketplace and bank aggregation, integrations, Public API), working with an engineering team that mixes backend and low-code engineers.
  • The first question on your desk: what works well and what needs improvement in the Public API, how does each consumer of the API fit in, and what is our next bet in terms of use case tu enable and push via API.
  • Tools: You work with the public API documentation (open to partners without a Qonto account), the developer portal, and AI tools. Being comfortable opening the docs or the code is part of the job.
  • Rituals: a daily product and tech sync by scope, a Monday product weekly with peers, a Friday debrief to share wins and struggles, and a Monthly Connect showcase of results and new features.

🏅 About you

  • Experience: You have solid product management experience and are comfortable owning a product that every other team contributes to, with a roadmap you have to build and defend yourself.
  • API and technical sensitivity (a plus): You have worked on an API, integration, platform or developer-facing product, or you learn technical topics fast. You’re comfortable getting hands-on with API documentation and working closely with engineers.
  • Stakeholder management and influence: You have aligned several teams around a shared product without hierarchical authority. You communicate clearly with PMs, engineers and senior stakeholders, and you consider the impact of your plan on every team before pushing it.
  • Nice to have: Fintech, payments or partner-integration background, and curiosity for AI tools and vibe coding (we learn it together at Qonto).
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.

This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.

We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

  • Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

  • Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

  • Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

  • Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

  • Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

  • Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

  • Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

  • Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

  • Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

  • Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

  • Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

  • Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

  • Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

  • Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

  • Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand

  • Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them

  • Are energized by having a lot of ownership and working closely with smart, mission-driven teammates

  • Are able to work on-site from our Zurich office

  • Bonus: You have legal domain familiarity, or experience in search and knowledge management, agentic search and data retrieval, or LegalTech – or you’ve worked in/with law firms, legal departments, or regulated industries

What you can look forward to:

  • A high-impact role in shaping a product and company with huge potential

  • The chance to work on the cutting edge of long-horizon agentic AI, applied to real-world legal work

  • A strong, technical, and collaborative team that’s serious about building great software

  • A culture that encourages experimentation, curiosity, and thoughtful decision-making

Submit your application by October 16th. Our team will review all candidates after the closing date and reach out regarding next steps.

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. As our next Engineering Manager for Identity, you’ll lead the team that builds and delivers the Identity and Access Management (IAM) foundation that powers the entire Camunda 8 platform, both on-premise and as part of our SaaS offering. This is a key role which can have a deep impact on Camunda’s success, offering you the chance to have a direct impact on the company’s growth.

As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

What You Will Do:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of reusable IAM components across the Camunda 8 stack—shaping authentication (multi‑protocol), authorization (RBAC), and federated organization management that work seamlessly for large, integration‑heavy enterprises.

  • Partner closely with multiple engineering teams, SREs, QA, and the Product Leadership Team to develop and drive a clear technical and product vision; transparently steward the roadmap and track commitments from support, incidents, and the product backlog.

  • Raise the bar on reliability and efficiency: keep build/release pipelines low‑effort and stable, ship security fixes within SLOs, and drive down support load, bug count, and incident rate.

  • Grow and coach a team of senior and developing engineers—setting clear expectations, giving actionable feedback, and creating a culture of autonomy, accountability, and continuous improvement, especially in an asynchronous, remote environment aligned to the DRI model.

  • Help mature our SaaS offering for large scale enterprise customers, ensuring it can easily integrate with our customer’s own IAM solutions in a safe, reliable way.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • Senior‑level technical depth in IAM and enterprise software: you can review designs, ask the right questions, and represent your team to technical and non‑technical stakeholders with clarity.

  • Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting.

  • Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes.

  • Background in product engineering for integration‑heavy B2B products (not primarily consulting), with a deep appreciation for enterprise needs around security, operability, and performance.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem.

  • Experience implementing IAM federation.

  • Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications.

  • Experience with L3 support/incident management.

  • Experience working in a fully remote organization.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Why this role?

 

As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

  • Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

  • Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

  • Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

What You Bring

  • You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

  • You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

  • You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

  • You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

  • You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

It’d Be Awesome If You Also…

  • Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

  • Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

  • Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

  • Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

  • Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: (Senior/Staff) Product Manager - Growth (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As a Senior or Staff-level Product Manager for Growth at bunch, you will lead a small Growth squad focused on discovering, validating, and shipping products that open the upmarket segment — larger VC funds and private equity managers whose scale and complexity put them beyond today’s product, but who become our most valuable customers the moment we can serve them.

This is greenfield work. You’ll start from real conversations with target accounts, not an inherited roadmap.

You will:

  • Own the Growth squad end to end: discovery, roadmap, build, and commercial outcomes

  • Work closely with Commercial to identify target accounts worth winning, then get in front of them through discovery calls, demos, and POC scoping

  • Identify recurring problems across upmarket accounts and decide what to build to deliver the highest ROI

  • Prototype fast — with the team and with AI tooling — so an idea becomes something a prospect can touch in weeks or months, not quarters

  • Run experiments knowing most will fail: kill the losers quickly and cheaply, and double down on what converts

  • Convert working prototypes into paid POCs, and paid POCs into signed contracts and product lines

  • Lead a small team of engineers as an active, hands-on product manager

About you

  • 7+ years in product, with a track record of taking ambiguous, zero-to-one problems to shipped, revenue-generating products

  • Experience operating at senior or staff level, with the ability to run a squad without someone setting direction for you

  • Strong fintech experience and comfort with financial services complexity, regulation, and sophisticated buyers

  • Commercial mindset: you think in business cases and ROI, can hold your own in front of a fund CFO or COO, and understand how discovery turns into POCs and signed contracts

  • Fluent with AI tools such as Claude, Lovable, or similar, especially for research, analysis, and prototyping

  • Experimental by temperament: energised by high-risk, high-reward work and able to design experiments so failures are fast and cheap

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and small teams; you would rather own one hard problem with two people than manage twenty on a roadmap someone else set

  • Exposure to private markets — VC, PE, fund administration, or working inside a GP or fund — is a plus

  • Experience in a growth, new-ventures, or incubation function is a plus

Success Indicators

  • A visible pipeline of experiments run, killed, or scaled, with clear reasoning for each

  • Paid MVPs landed with accounts previously out of reach

  • MVPs with a clear path to signed contracts in the upmarket segment

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 min) – Collaboration, ownership, and product/commercial fit

  3. Product Case Interview (60 min) – Problem discovery, experimentation, and prioritisation

  4. Cross-functional Interview (60 min) – Commercial collaboration, stakeholder management, and impact

  5. Final Round (60 min) – Meet senior leaders from Product and Commercial

    Optional Meet & Greet (30 min) – Meet your future teammates

Questions? Reach out to

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

  • Glossary – Explore commonly used private market terms

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

jobs.description:
Wemolo ist kein gewöhnliches Unternehmen – wir revolutionieren das eher konservative Parkraummanagement mit modernster Technologie 🚀

Bei Wemolo steht das Produkt im Mittelpunkt. Was du beginnst, bringst du auch zu Ende. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung Hand in Hand gehen. Bist du bereit, deine eigene Entwicklung – und unsere gemeinsame – aktiv voranzutreiben?

Als Product Manager (all genders) – IoT Platform übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen entscheidenden Teil: die cloud- und webbasierte Plattform hinter unserer vernetzten Hardware-Flotte. Deine Arbeit liegt an der Schnittstelle von internen Tools, ereignisgesteuerter Plattformlogik und der Skalierbarkeit operativer Prozesse.

Du arbeitest eng mit einer Vielzahl von Stakeholdern zusammen, insbesondere mit den Teams System Performance, Customer Success, Technical Implementation, Installations sowie weiteren Product- & Engineering-Teams.

What to expect

  • Ownership: Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für einen strategisch wichtigen Teil unserer IoT-Plattform – von der Problem- und Bedarfsermittlung über Priorisierung und Umsetzung bis hin zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • Strategy: Du entwickelst und steuerst die Produktstrategie für operative Tools – von Konfiguration und Rollout über Monitoring bis hin zum Flottenmanagement

  • User focus: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse der internen Nutzer in unseren Operations-Teams und übersetzt diese in skalierbare Produktverbesserungen

  • Platform capabilities: Du verantwortest ereignisgesteuerte Services wie die Erfassung der Parkplatzbelegung und weitere plattformbasierte Funktionen, die aus Gerätedaten entstehen

  • Scalability: Du stellst sicher, dass die Plattformlogik zuverlässig, transparent überwachbar und skalierbar ist – auch für zunehmend komplexe und geschäftskritische Anwendungsfälle

  • Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Engineering zusammen und stimmst dich über Operations, Product und Leadership hinweg ab, um technische Rahmenbedingungen, Nutzerbedürfnisse und geschäftliche Prioritäten in Einklang zu bringen

Inspire us by

  • Product-Erfahrung: 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in der ganzheitlichen Verantwortung für komplexe Software- oder Plattformprodukte – von der Definition des Problems bis zur Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du fühlst dich mit Backend-, Cloud- und Systemarchitektur-Themen wohl und kannst mit Engineers fundiert über technische Abwägungen sprechen.

  • Stakeholder- & Datenkompetenz: Du bist stark darin, funktionsübergreifende Teams zusammenzubringen und Produktentscheidungen auf Basis von Daten, Monitoring und Nutzerfeedback zu treffen.

  • Background: Erfahrung in den Bereichen Plattformen, SaaS, Infrastruktur, operative Systeme, IoT oder hardware-nahen Umgebungen – einschließlich interner Tools – ist von Vorteil.

  • Architekturkenntnisse: Du bist mit verteilten Systemen und ereignisgesteuerten Architekturen vertraut und kennst Technologien wie Kafka und MQTT.

  • Sprache: Fließendes Englisch (C1+) wird vorausgesetzt, Deutsch ist ein Plus.

  • Mobilität nach Maß: Volle Fahrt voraus - Ob nachhaltig mit Bike-Leasing oder bequem mit Fahrtkostenzuschuss, wir halten dich mobil und flexibel auf Kurs

  • KI im Alltag: KI ist bei uns kein Buzzword, sondern Teil deines Workflows – für bessere Insights, schnellere Lösungen und weniger repetitive Aufgaben.

  • Ownership & Gestaltungsspielraum: Dein Impact, deine Bilanz - Übernimm volle Ownership für deinen Bereich und deine KPIs

Intro

Every industrial company on our customer list, ZF, Schaeffler, Miele, Maersk, Lufthansa, is fighting the same challenge: margin erosion from tariffs, CBAM, and supply chains nobody fully understands anymore. We're not another SaaS tool competing for budget. We're the difference between a board that knows its cost exposure and one that finds out the hard way. As Account Executive, you own that conversation end to end, first call to signed contract, for the deals that actually move the needle.

Why this seat is different
The deals are long-cycle, technical, and multi-stakeholder, procurement, sustainability, and operations all in the room, often with conflicting priorities. If you've sold complex B2B SaaS where the win depends on translating technical value into board-level urgency, this is that seat, at a stage early enough that you'll shape how we do it, not just execute a playbook someone else wrote.


Your tasks

  • Own the entire sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, negotiation, close
  • Build and run your own outbound strategy across LinkedIn, phone, email, and your own network
  • Lead demos and presentations that translate technical product value into business urgency for enterprise buyers
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder enterprise deals (procurement, sustainability, technical) without losing momentum
  • Keep your pipeline clean and current in our CRM
  • Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to keep what we sell aligned with what we can deliver
  • Bring market and competitor intel back to the team to sharpen our positioning


Your profile

  • Proven track record running full-cycle enterprise B2B SaaS sales, with a strong trajectory (quota overachievement, fast progression) weighted more heavily than years alone

  • Comfortable managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with technical and non-technical buyers

  • Experience selling into industrial or regulated sectors (automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, logistics, chemicals) is a strong plus; we're equally interested in strong operators from adjacent complex B2B environments

  • Fluent in German and English; most of our enterprise buyers are German-speaking

  • Hands-on CRM experience (Salesforce or HubSpot)

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Munich, in-person presence 3 days/week, with regular travel to customers


Benefits

  • Unique & Powerful Mission: join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
  • Compensation & Rewards: a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package, including virtual stock options

  • Connection & Networking: Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
  • Trust & Transparency: monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals

jobs.title: Director Business Development (TV)
jobs.description:
Shape our AI products with a real say on the roadmap, and win the TV customers who will use them. You find the telcos, Pay TV operators and broadcasters that should run on the 3Ready platform, reach their decision makers early, and take each opportunity from first conversation to signed contract. You sell on outcomes, with our 3Ready products and our operator references behind you. You work directly with management and have the freedom to build business development for TV your way. Every new customer goes to our customer success team, who grow the account from there.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own a qualified pipeline of new TV operators across Europe and selected international markets.
  • Open conversations with CXOs, heads of product and executive leaders before an RFP is written.
  • Listen first: understand an operator's problems before proposing, and position 3Ready Hero, Control Center and Framework on what they change (engagement, retention and cost).
  • Own every RFP and RFI end to end with our Solutions and product teams, including the commercial part.
  • Propose and run paid PoCs and pilots with clear success criteria and a path to contract.
  • Negotiate and close from a clear packaging and pricing model, with the authority to decide within it.
  • Write and run the TV sales strategy and plan, including the yearly events plan. Lead the weekly business development rhythm with marketing and run a rolling forecast.
  • Hand each signed customer over to customer success with a complete file, and stay involved through kick-off.
  • Bring what you hear in the market back into our roadmap and positioning.
  • Represent 3SS at IBC, and other industry events.

How you lead

  • Act like the owner: you set the plan, make the call and answer for the result.
  • Start from the viewer: you know the operator's app and explain our value in viewer outcomes.
  • Decide with evidence: data, clear hypotheses and paid PoCs, learning fast from every win and loss.
  • Shape the product: you turn what you hear in the market into clear problem statements for our product teams.
  • Raise the bar: honest feedback, strong preparation, and every customer conversation better than the last.

Requirements

  • At least 10 years in business development or enterprise sales for B2B software, of which at least 5 selling to telcos, Pay TV operators or broadcasters, with a record of new logos signed.
  • A network in operator product, technology and executive teams, ideally in Europe.
  • Experience running complex sales cycles end to end: qualification, RFPs, PoCs, negotiation, contract.
  • Value-based selling: you show return on investment, handle objections, and move deals that stall in slow decision processes.
  • A consultative style: enough product and technical depth to advise an operator on TV platforms, Android TV and AI-driven discovery without a solution architect in the room, and the judgement to know when to bring one.
  • Discipline with pipeline and CRM. Your forecast is one others can plan on.
  • The drive to win new logos and build business development in a company of our size, hands-on first, building a team later.
  • Fluent English. German is a plus.
  • Location: Stuttgart, Germany, or elsewhere in Europe, with regular presence in Stuttgart and travel to operators and industry events.

Strong plus

  • Background in product management, a product-led software company, or UX and OTT consulting. You can run a discovery workshop with an operator's product team and read a prototype or user flow.
  • Experience selling TV middleware, UI platforms, recommendation or search products to operators.
  • Experience with Android TV Operator Tier deployments.
  • Experience working with platform partners or system integrators in the TV space.

Benefits

  • A competitive base salary plus a performance bonus tied to new customer revenue, qualified pipeline and the long-term value of the accounts you win.
  • Real ownership: authority to decide on target accounts, bid or no bid, offers, PoC scope and discounts within the pricing frame.
  • A real say on the roadmap of our AI products, and the freedom to build TV business development your way.
  • Direct access to management and a seat in the core team with our CTO, Solutions and product leads.
  • Flexibility: based in Stuttgart or elsewhere in Europe, remote-friendly.
  • References that open doors, such as Vodafone and Proximus, and visibility at IBC, NAB and other industry events.

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, with proven expertise in the cybersecurity domain.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity market dynamics, customer pain points, and competitive positioning. You can speak confidently about MDR, EDR, IR, and related technologies.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value.

  • Strategic and analytical mindset with a bias for action. Comfortable setting direction and executing with high agency.

  • Experience working in remote, fast-growing environments where marketing operates with both strategic and hands-on responsibility.

  • Startup or scale-up background at a high-growth company.

  • Experience with positioning frameworks and go-to-market methodologies.

  • Track record of successful product launches or market repositioning initiatives.

  • Prior experience in vendor-led or partner-enabled go-to-market models.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • Full strategic ownership of a mission-critical product area in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

  • Mentorship and growth: lead and develop the next generation of product managers; grow into broader strategy and leadership roles.

  • A remote-friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats (in Spain, Portugal, Italy…).

  • Weekly lunches (NL) and Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including equity participation.

Are you up for it?

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. Your profile

  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
  • AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest
  • Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to
  • A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs
  • Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role
  • Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan
  • Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm

How we hire

Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step:

1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko
2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day
3. Case study: a hands-on part (AI tools explicitly welcome – walk us through how you used them) and a 45-minute architecture session
4. Team panel and a 45-minute conversation with our CPTO – optionally on site

FAQ

Is this a people-management role? No. It's a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through architecture, standards and enablement, without direct reports.

Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Your mandate is to take it from individual productivity to organization-wide practice.

Self-Serve Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Self-Serve PM to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative's user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

You'll own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That includes how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There's no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.

What you'll do

  • Own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, onboarding, lifecycle, and go-to-market levers to drive results

  • Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

  • Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

  • Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

  • Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

  • Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

  • Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

  • Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products

  • A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving them across multiple levers

  • Deep familiarity with the creative space and the creators and marketers who use these tools, with a habit of bringing user insights into every product decision

  • Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

  • Design-minded, with a high bar for quality and user experience and the ability to mock up concepts yourself

  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on how things are built and the tradeoffs involved

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort in product analytics tools to find opportunities and measure impact

  • A track record of shipping quickly and iterating based on what the data shows

  • Ownership pedigree, meaning you drive your own projects fully rather than handing off after the spec

  • Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Role Overview

As VP Engineering, you own the Engineering organization and turn our platform and AI vision into shipped systems. You report to the Chief Product Officer and partner closely with product, commercial, operations, and finance. You lead our Senior Product Engineers, Staff Engineers and QA, and work closely with our product managers, who own product and design.

This is an execution mandate. You carve our core systems into a modern platform, build our AI agents into one holistic system that runs the trade lifecycle end-to-end, and scale the teams that deliver it. You inherit a working machine at full speed: your job is to rebuild it in flight without losing a day of momentum. In your first year, the priorities are the carve-out of our transaction core and bringing our AI agents into one orchestrating layer.

Key Responsibilities

AI and Automation

  • Build our AI agents into one holistic, orchestrating AI layer across sourcing, pricing, quoting, sales, logistics, and financing.

  • Drive automation of the full transaction lifecycle, and own automation-rate and no-touch-quote targets as first-class delivery KPIs.

  • Work with our data team, which sits with the CPO, on systems that make our trade flows a compounding advantage, so every transaction makes the system smarter.

  • Keep us at the practical frontier of agentic AI: ship what creates leverage now, skip what is demo-ware.

  • Put the guardrails, evals, and human-in-the-loop controls in place so automation stays reliable where it matters most: money-touching and customer-facing paths, where a wrong output is a real loss, not just a bug.

Platform and Architecture

  • Own execution of the target architecture for the Andercore platform, the system of record for industrial trade.

  • Lead the carve-out of our transaction core into a modern, modular light ERP (a lean core system for our trade transactions), with a clear migration path and zero disruption to daily trading.

  • Shape the role of Salesforce in our landscape: decide what stays on the platform, what moves to the new core, and how the two work together.

  • Make pragmatic build-vs-buy calls within the platform strategy and keep technology cost per transaction on a falling curve.

  • Make new-market launch a repeatable platform motion: multiple geographies, currencies, languages, and compliance regimes, built in rather than bolted on.

  • Keep the platform ready to pass technical due diligence at any moment: architecture, data, and security in shape for the next financing round.

Engineering Organization and Talent

  • Lead the Engineering organization: onsite talent in Berlin and a nearshoring team. Team structure and ways of working stay in-house, and you manage the nearshoring team directly and actively, not at arm's length through a vendor.

  • Build lean by default. The goal is not to grow headcount but to build a small, high-leverage team and raise output through AI across the engineering workflow. You lead as an AI-first engineering leader.

  • Hire and develop senior engineering leaders, including 1–2 Staff Engineers who report to you and own architecture across teams, and raise the talent bar with every hire.

  • Build an engineering culture of ownership, speed, and craftsmanship: small teams, high leverage, no bureaucracy.

  • Stay hands-on: review designs with your Staff Engineers, pair on the hardest problems, unblock teams, and keep decisions close to the code.

Enablement and Data Integrity

  • Enable business teams to build and automate with AI safely. Set the paved paths, standards, and review practices that let non-engineers move fast without compromising quality, security, or the systems underneath.

  • Partner with the CPO, who owns data, on data integrity: build systems that keep one source of truth with clear access and quality controls, so that faster building never degrades the data the company runs on.

  • Make speed and safety one operating model, not a trade-off, and communicate it across the company so every team knows how to move quickly within clear boundaries.

Delivery and Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as technical sparring partner to the CPO on architecture, roadmap feasibility, and sequencing.

  • Translate the product roadmap into shipped software, and turn front-line needs from commercial and operations into delivery.

  • Support the CPO and CEO in technical due diligence with a clear, numbers-backed view of architecture, data, and AI.

  • Communicate technical priorities and trade-offs transparently across the company, so everyone understands what we build and why.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering operates with clear ownership and no loss of delivery speed.

  • Our transaction core runs on a modern, modular platform: the carve-out is live and the migration path is executed.

  • One orchestrating AI system increases automation rate and transactions per employee, quarter over quarter.

  • Technology cost per transaction falls while volume grows.

  • Architecture, systems, and AI stand up to any technical due diligence.

  • Hiring runs fast and consistently: senior hires close within six weeks, with one bar across interviewers.

What You Bring

  • Senior engineering leadership at scale, having run and grown multi-team organizations, ideally across more than one location.

  • Deep experience with transactional platforms, ERP-style systems, or comparable systems of record, ideally including regulated financial flows such as payments, lending, or KYC, and re-platforming or carve-outs in a live environment.

  • Hands-on track record shipping AI or ML in production, with a real sense for where agentic AI creates leverage today.

  • A demonstrated AI-first, lean mindset: you have applied AI in your own engineering organization to raise output without growing headcount, not just talked about it.

  • Strong architectural judgment, with security and data protection built into your decisions, and enough technical depth to stay close to the code.

  • The judgment to know where reliability must be absolute and where speed wins: you move fast on everything reversible and hold a high correctness bar on the irreversible, money-touching paths.

  • A plus: a track record of enabling non-engineering teams to build safely with AI, balancing speed

  • against quality and data integrity, and the communication skills to carry that across a whole company.

  • A plus: comfort in a company where operations come first and software follows, turning manual services into products.

  • A commercial mindset: you anchor engineering decisions in unit economics, working capital, and speed for buyers and suppliers.

  • A plus: experience with Salesforce as part of a larger system landscape.

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin

  • Process: conversations with the CPO, the CEO, Chief of Staff, and members of the engineering team.
