jobs.title: Customer Support Team Lead
jobs.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance, and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Support team as the direct manager of a group of Support Engineers. While the function operates globally, with part of the team in Paris and the rest in New York, this specific role is based in Paris.

You will report to Matthieu, Global Head of Scale CS, and your manager, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also partner closely with Support Operations, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, and IT. You will also be part of the global Go-To-Market community across our international offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As Support Team Lead, you will be the direct manager of our Support Engineers and accountable for the team's day-to-day performance, development, and service delivery. You will translate our Support strategy into effective routines, consistent execution, and an excellent customer experience.

This is a player-coach role. Your primary focus is managing and developing the team, but you'll stay close to operations, supporting complex investigations, reviewing ticket quality, and coordinating escalations when needed. The Head of Support defines the strategy and long-term evolution of the function. You make sure the team delivers on it every day.

We're looking for someone who is a natural people developer: accountable, structured, thorough, calm under pressure, data-informed, proactive, and collaborative. We strongly believe in growing our people internally, and this role is also a strong stepping stone toward broader Support and Customer Success leadership for those who want to keep growing.

People Management & Team Development

Directly manage, coach, and develop the Support Engineers to help them perform at their best and grow in their careers:

  • Hold regular one-to-ones, set clear expectations, and provide frequent, actionable feedback

  • Monitor individual performance, address issues when needed, and lead performance reviews and development plans

  • Identify skills gaps and organize coaching, training, and knowledge-sharing

  • Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, and participate in hiring

  • Foster a culture of customer empathy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Daily Service Delivery & Escalation Management

Own the daily delivery of Support and act as the first point of management escalation for complex, urgent, or sensitive cases:

  • Monitor ticket queues, backlog, workload, and service levels, and ensure tickets are correctly prioritized and followed through

  • Organize team coverage (absences, shifts, peak periods) and step in when service delivery is at risk

  • Review and coordinate escalated tickets, defining next steps and involving the right internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success)

  • Coordinate customer communication on significant cases, and escalate major risks or executive concerns to the Head of Support

Quality, Process, & Performance

Maintain high standards of technical quality, and bring a critical, structured eye to how Support operates today, proposing and driving changes rather than simply preserving the status quo:

  • Identify where tickets could be resolved faster and more efficiently in writing, and reduce the number of cases that unnecessarily escalate into calls, especially multi-stakeholder ones, to protect everyone's time and improve the ROI of customer interactions

  • Review ticket quality using QA tools and scorecards, and coach the team based on the results

  • Ensure investigations are structured, well-documented, and clearly communicated to customers

  • Monitor operational and quality indicators (backlog, response/resolution time, CSAT, quality scores) to identify risks and drive corrective action

  • Document, monitor adoption of, and continuously improve Support workflows, in partnership with Support Operations

Cross-functional Collaboration

Make sure Support works effectively with the rest of the business.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on customer investigations and product issues

  • Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales on customer situations requiring Support involvement, and continuously refine which team owns which type of request across the client lifecycle

  • Clarify responsibilities and handovers between Support and other teams, and represent the team's operational needs in cross-functional discussions

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Zendesk (or an equivalent ticketing platform), our data stack tools, Microsoft Office, UpSlide, and internal knowledge-base tools (or local equivalents).

⚡Your goals

You will be assessed on:

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

  • Time to Resolution (TTR)

  • Ticket-to-active-user ratio

  • Team engagement and development


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Proven experience managing or leading a customer-facing team, ideally in B2B SaaS, technical support, or a similar operational environment

  • Strong coaching and people-development skills, including the ability to give clear, constructive, and sometimes difficult feedback

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities across a team

  • Experience using service or operational metrics to identify issues and improve performance

  • Strong customer communication and escalation-management skills

  • Ability to understand technical issues and guide structured investigations, without needing to personally own every ticket

  • Fluent in French & English mandatory

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and other customer-facing teams

  • A pragmatic, accountable approach to problem-solving, with a bias for ownership over escalation

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience directly managing a team of five or more people

  • Experience supporting Enterprise customers

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Office add-ins, deployment, or IT environments

  • Familiarity with Zendesk or a similar ticketing platform

  • Experience with quality and knowledge management, or Support Operations

  • Experience supporting distributed or international teams

  • Familiarity with automation, AI-assisted Support, or self-service strategies

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your management experience in Support.

  3. Case study and a team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  4. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

💻 Hybrid work: 2-3 days in-office per week

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

👶 Family support:

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

Ways of working

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
Head of PMO
jobs.description:
About Us

 

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to manage repairs, maintenance, compliance, and contractor operations at scale. Our platform combines marketplace infrastructure, workflow software, automation, and operational analytics. It is designed for the complexity, volume, and regulatory demands of social housing, public sector property portfolios, and large residential operations. We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany. We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you want to work on hard, real-world problems in the world's largest asset class, we would like to hear from you.


Role purpose

Plentific is standing up a Controlling PMO: a function with the mandate to set and enforce common delivery standards, hold a single, current view of the whole portfolio, and work directly with senior management to unblock the issues that put individual projects’ targets at risk. The PMO Lead owns this function day to day — coaching Programme and Project Managers (PMs) to a consistently high standard, building the portfolio-level reporting that gives leadership real visibility, and acting as the bridge between delivery teams and senior management when a decision or an unblock is needed.

This is a hands-on, first-of-its-kind role at Plentific: the PMO Lead will stand up the standards, cadence, and reporting described below largely from scratch, and will be judged on how quickly the portfolio becomes visible, consistent, and genuinely governed as a result.


Key responsibilities

1. Coach Programme & Project Managers, and hold the standard

  • Own and continuously improve the standard toolkit every programme uses — charter, RAID log, status report, change log.

  • Coach PMs on using the standards well — raising the general standard of programme management practice, not just chasing form-filling.

  • Own the stage-gate review process: assess whether a programme is genuinely ready to pass each gate, and issue go/no-go sign-off.

  • Set and enforce mandatory reporting — PMs submit standard, current status on a fixed cadence; the PMO follows up where reporting lapses.

2. Build and run portfolio-level reporting and governance

  • Consolidate individual programme status into one current, accurate portfolio view of schedule, spend, risk, and resourcing.

  • Own the portfolio tracker and the cadence of updates that feed it.

  • Track cross-programme risks and dependencies; make sure each has a named owner and a clear escalation threshold.

  • Prepare and present the portfolio report at each Steering Committee review.

  • Track benefits realisation — confirm delivered programmes actually produced the outcome they were funded for.

3. Work with senior management to report and unblock

  • Act as the primary escalation point when a programme risk or dependency needs a decision above the PM’s authority.

  • Bring blockers to the right senior stakeholder quickly, with a clear ask and options — not just a status update.

  • Represent delivery status and risk to senior management accurately and without spin, including when the news is difficult.

  • Chair or co-chair the portfolio review, and prepare materials for Steering Committee meetings.

  • Track follow-through on decisions and unblocks agreed with senior management, so they don’t silently drop.


Authority and mandate

This role carries a Controlling PMO mandate — meaning the successful candidate has the authority to require compliance, not just recommend it:

  • Authority, via the PMO charter, to require compliance with standards and mandatory reporting across all active programmes.

  • Owns sign-off at stage gates — a programme cannot proceed to the next phase without PMO gate approval.

  • Is the named escalation path for cross-programme risk and resourcing conflicts.

  • Does not directly manage PMs day to day: PMs remain people-managed within their business unit, with a functional (“dotted-line”) reporting relationship into the PMO for delivery standards, gate compliance, and escalation.


Key relationships

  • Executive Sponsor / Steering Committee — monthly portfolio reporting, escalation, gate decisions.

  • Programme & Project Managers — coaching, mandatory reporting, gate reviews.

  • Senior management / business leaders — status reporting, unblocking, resourcing conversations.

  • PMO Analyst (future hire) — as the portfolio grows, this role would oversee a second PMO hire supporting reporting and gate reviews.


How success is measured

  • On-time delivery rate across active programmes.

  • Forecast accuracy — how closely planned cost and effort track actuals over time.

  • Share of active programmes with an up-to-date RAID log.

  • Time from a risk being raised to being escalated to someone who can unblock it.

  • Sponsor and PM confidence in delivery, tracked each quarter.


Person specification

Essential

  • Proven experience running programme or project governance, ideally in a PMO capacity, in a fast-moving organisation.

  • Comfortable holding people accountable to standards without owning their day-to-day work — a coaching style, not a command style.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills; credible in the room with senior leadership.

  • Confident synthesising status across multiple concurrent initiatives into a single, honest, current view.

  • A clear, direct communicator, comfortable surfacing bad news early rather than letting it surface late.

Desirable

  • A formal programme/PMO qualification (e.g. P3O, PRINCE2, MSP, PMP).

  • Experience standing up a PMO from scratch, or maturing one from a Supportive to a Controlling model.

  • Familiarity with portfolio/PPM reporting tools.

Benefits

 

As you can see, we are quickly progressing with our ambitious plans and are eager to grow our team of doers to achieve our vision of managing over 2 million properties through our platform across various countries. You can help us shape the future of property management across the globe. Here’s what we offer:

Mit Büros in Berlin, Kopenhagen, Oslo und Groningen sind wir ein internationales Team, das Technologie und gesellschaftliche Wirkung verbindet. Bereits über 10.000 Kirchengemeinden in Europa vertrauen auf ChurchDesk.

Warum Du Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte werden solltest?

Kirchen stehen mitten in einem tiefgreifenden Wandel – und immer mehr große kirchliche Organisationen setzen dabei auf ChurchDesk. Unser Enterprise-Geschäft im DACH-Raum steht auf einem starken Fundament. Als Enterprise Account Executive sorgst Du dafür, dass es weiter wächst: Du überzeugst (Erz-)Bistümer, Diözesen, Landeskirchen und kirchliche Verbände von ChurchDesk und führst sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Unterschrift. Eine Rolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, echter Verantwortung und einer Wirkung, die weit über Zahlen hinausgeht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden im DACH-Raum durch gezielte Outbound-Aktivitäten, die Bearbeitung von Inbound-Leads und den Aufbau eines starken Netzwerks in der kirchlichen Landschaft.

  • Du führst komplexe Sales-Zyklen eigenständig – von Prospecting und Bedarfsanalyse über Präsentationen bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

  • Du verstehst die Strukturen und Herausforderungen großer kirchlicher Organisationen und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.

  • Du navigierst souverän durch Organisationen mit vielen Beteiligten – von Leitungsebenen über Fachabteilungen bis zu Gremien.

  • Du pflegst eine gesunde Pipeline, erstellst verlässliche Forecasts und übernimmst Verantwortung für Dein eigenes Umsatzziel.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success, Produkt und Marketing zusammen und sorgst für eine reibungslose Übergabe neuer Kunden.

  • Du vertrittst ChurchDesk professionell bei Kundenterminen vor Ort, auf Fachkonferenzen und gegenüber hochrangigen kirchlichen Entscheidungsträgern.


  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise als Account Executive mit Fokus auf Enterprise-Kunden im SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Du hast bereits erfolgreich Neukunden gewonnen und weißt, wie man auch in längeren, komplexen Sales-Zyklen ans Ziel kommt.

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb an stakeholder-getriebene Organisationen, idealerweise im kirchlichen, NGO- oder öffentlichen Umfeld.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Verhandlungskompetenz – auch auf Führungs- und Leitungsebene.

  • Du fühlst Dich in HubSpot zu Hause und nutzt es, um Deine Pipeline strukturiert im Blick zu behalten.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des DACH-Raums.

  • Eine proaktive, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und Interesse an der Mission von ChurchDesk und der Rolle der Kirche in einer sich wandelnden Gesellschaft.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Eine Rolle in einem wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen, in der du echte Verantwortung übernimmst, deine Arbeit aktiv mitgestaltest und dabei viel dazulernst.

  • Wachse mit uns: Ein dedizierter Sales Coach an deiner Seite sowie die Möglichkeit, dich durch Kurse und Webinare technisch und im Pre-Sales stetig weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Zukunft im Blick – Wir bezuschussen deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 %, damit du heute gut arbeitest und morgen gut abgesichert bist.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub – weil ausreichend Erholung wichtig ist.

  • 37 Stunden Arbeitswoche – mehr Balance, mehr Zeit für dich.

  • Eine offene und ehrliche Feedbackkultur – gemeinsam wachsen, voneinander lernen, transparent kommunizieren.

  • Ein wunderschönes, modernes Altbau-Office im Herzen Neukölln – zentral, lebendig und perfekt angebunden. 

  • Lust auf einen Tapetenwechsel? Besuche uns in Kopenhagen, Oslo oder Groningen! Wir übernehmen deine Reise- und Spesenkosten.

  • Unvergessliche Team-Erlebnisse – von Company Events bis zu gemeinsamen Reisen nach Kroatien & Prag.

Über ChurchDesk

Bei ChurchDesk sind wir der Meinung, dass die Kirche eine wichtige Rolle in der Gesellschaft spielt. Unsere Plattform wird von Tausenden von Gemeinden genutzt, um ihre Arbeit zu organisieren, die Kommunikation mit Mitgliedern zu verbessern, mehr Menschen zu erreichen und neue Möglichkeiten der Mittelbeschaffung zu erschließen.
Unsere Kunden sind Teil einer der größten und ältesten Institutionen der Welt: der Kirche. Sie befindet sich in einem erheblichen Wandel, um sich auf die Zukunft vorzubereiten – und wir sind hier, um diese Transformation zu unterstützen. Für Kirchen in ganz Europa ist es entscheidend, effizienter zu arbeiten und mit ihren Mitgliedern und Gemeinden in Verbindung zu bleiben.

ChurchDesk gibt es seit mehr als 15 Jahren – von einem Startup zu einem internationalen Unternehmen, das Kunden in ganz Europa bedient. Und wir fangen gerade erst an!

Wir leben unsere Werte aktiv in unserer täglichen Arbeit:

#challenge: Wir fordern uns selbst – und unsere Kunden – kontinuierlich heraus, uns zu verbessern. Wir arbeiten wie ein professionelles Sportteam: mit Ehrgeiz, Disziplin und starkem Teamgeist.

#dogoodbusiness: Gutes Geschäft zu machen ist ein Marathon, kein Sprint. Es erfordert Ausdauer, Qualität und Integrität – jeden einzelnen Tag.

#jointheride: Die Reise ist genauso wichtig wie das Ziel. Seien Sie ein Teil davon, feiern Sie Erfolge – und haben Sie Spaß! Wir schätzen es, zusammen zu sein, besonders im Büro.

Das trifft auf dich zu? Dann lass uns gerne eine Initiativbewerbung zukommen!

Du übernimmst die eigenverantwortliche Bearbeitung verschiedener Themenstellungen.
Du arbeitest aktiv in unterschiedlichen Projekten mit.

Dein Profil

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in einem relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Berufsausbildung.
Du findest dich in einem dieser Bereiche wieder: Grafikdesign/Frontend, Backend, Business Intelligence, Marketing, Controlling oder Customer Support und hast entsprechend fundierte Fachkenntnisse.

jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren



Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

jobs.title: US Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
US Marketing Lead

Location: United States

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution.

The Role

The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States.

You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working.

You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team.

What You’ll Own

US Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities.

  • Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth.

  • Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market.

  • Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities.

  • Bring insights from customers, prospects, competitors, and the market back into the broader marketing organization.

Demand Generation and Campaigns

  • Partner with Growth Lead to build and run integrated campaigns across email, paid media, content, webinars, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels.

  • Create campaigns around Teton’s most important customer problems and product capabilities.

  • Own regional email strategy, segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign follow-up.

  • Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement.

  • Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments.

  • Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, followed up on, and measured in HubSpot.

Sales Enablement

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to the US sales organization.

  • Develop and maintain US-specific sales decks, case studies, one-pagers, proposals, follow-up materials, and campaign assets.

  • Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators.

  • Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward.

  • Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities.

  • Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement.

Events, Webinars, and Partnerships

  • Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment.

  • Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline.

  • Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging.

  • Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities.

Content, Customer Stories, and PR

  • Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets.

  • Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators.

  • Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars.

  • Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships.

  • Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market.

Product Positioning and Market Intelligence

  • Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative.

  • Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process.

  • Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively.

  • Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness.

  • Maintain clear dashboards and regular updates for Marketing and US commercial leadership.

  • Use performance data to improve targeting, messaging, campaign investment, and sales follow-up.

  • Establish a consistent process for evaluating what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Established a clear and credible US marketing strategy tied to Teton’s commercial goals.

  • Built a consistent campaign engine that generates qualified demand and supports pipeline growth.

  • Improved the quality and consistency of US sales enablement.

  • Created a repeatable approach to US events, webinars, partnerships, and account-based programs.

  • Expanded Teton’s library of US customer proof points and case studies.

  • Increased Teton’s visibility and credibility with senior living operators and industry stakeholders.

  • Created transparent reporting that shows how US marketing contributes to revenue.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in healthcare technology, senior living, or enterprise software industry.

  • Experience owning a regional, vertical, or business-unit marketing strategy.

  • A track record of building integrated campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong sales enablement experience and the ability to work closely with enterprise sales teams.

  • Experience with events, content, email marketing, webinars, account-based marketing, and demand generation.

  • Excellent writing, editing, messaging, and presentation skills.

  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Comfort working in a fast-growing company where priorities can change and processes are still being built.

  • Strong analytical judgment and experience using marketing and CRM data to make decisions.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and related marketing tools is preferred.

  • Knowledge of the US senior living or healthcare market is highly valuable.

The Person We Think Will Thrive

You are a strong generalist who knows how to turn company goals into focused regional execution. You can write a campaign brief, improve a sales deck, develop an event plan, interview a customer, analyze lead performance, and present a clear recommendation to leadership.

You are commercially minded, comfortable working directly with sales, and focused on producing work that helps the company grow. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process, and you know how to balance brand building with near-term pipeline needs.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

jobs.title: Senior IT Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Role

The Senior IT Analyst is the principal in-house resource responsible for day-to-day IT support, providing first and second-line user support and day-to-day IT operations for approximately 80 users. As the principal person responsible for day-to-day IT operations, they will take ownership of incidents and service requests across the support lifecycle rather than operating solely as an escalation resource.
 
This is a broad, senior analyst role for someone who is technically capable, comfortable working independently and able to manage competing priorities. The postholder will respond directly to users, resolve routine enquiries and requests, investigate more complex issues through to resolution and coordinate external technology suppliers where specialist expertise is needed. Alongside business-as-usual responsibilities, the role will support and deliver smaller technology projects and service improvements.
 
By keeping FAIRR’s technology secure, reliable and easy to use, the role enables colleagues to focus on delivering FAIRR’s mission with investors and partners worldwide.


Key Outcomes & Accountabilities

OUTCOME 1: Users receive dependable, responsive IT support, with issues owned and resolved end to end

  • Act as the principal in-house point of contact for day-to-day IT support, providing both first and second-line assistance according to operational needs.
  • Resolve straightforward incidents and requests promptly, while taking the lead on more complex technical issues requiring deeper investigation and second-line expertise.
  • Own and manage incidents and service requests from initial contact through to resolution, including access, software, equipment, permissions and non-standard user requirements, coordinating third-party suppliers or specialist support when required.
  • Monitor recurring issues, identify root causes and implement practical improvements to reduce repeat incidents.
  • Maintain accurate support records and produce clear information on service volumes, performance, trends and user experience.
 
OUTCOME 2: Joiners, movers and leavers have the right access and equipment at the right time, and no more
  • Coordinate all IT activities for joiners, movers and leavers in collaboration with HR and relevant managers.
  • Create, amend and remove user accounts, licences, group memberships, permissions and application access accurately and on time, including removal of leaver access no later than the end of their last working day (or earlier where instructed by P&C).
  • Prepare, issue, recover and securely manage laptops, mobile devices, peripherals and other IT equipment.
  • Perform periodic access reviews and maintain appropriate evidence of approvals and completed actions.
  • Manage shared, service and other non-person accounts, ensuring ownership, purpose and access are recorded.
  • Where instructed by P&C or the Senior IT Manager, securely preserve or retrieve account and device data to support subject access requests, investigations or legal matters, maintaining confidentiality throughout.
 
OUTCOME 3: IT changes are implemented in a controlled way with minimal disruption
  • Plan, assess, document, communicate and implement routine IT changes in a controlled manner.
  • Ensure changes have appropriate approvals, testing, implementation steps, back-out arrangements and post-change review where proportionate.
  • Maintain the IT change schedule and coordinate activities to minimise disruption to users and business operations.
  • Communicate planned changes clearly to affected users and stakeholders.
  • Where changes need to take place outside normal working hours, schedule these in advance with the Senior IT Manager’s agreement (see Section 8).
 
OUTCOME 4: IT services and workplace technology operate reliably and are used effectively and securely
  • Administer Microsoft 365 and other cloud applications used by the organisation, including routine configuration, licence and user administration.
  • Support laptops, mobile devices, meeting-room technology, printers, connectivity and standard workplace applications.
  • Coordinate hardware repairs, replacements, warranty cases, software renewals and operational supplier activities.
  • Maintain user guides, knowledge articles, standard operating procedures and support documentation.
  • Provide practical guidance and training that helps users make effective and secure use of technology.
 
OUTCOME 5: IT records, controls and evidence are complete, current and audit-ready
  • Maintain complete and accurate asset, software, licence, supplier and other operational IT registers.
  • Record equipment allocation, ownership, status, location, lifecycle and disposal information, and perform periodic reconciliations.
  • Follow and help maintain IT policies, standards, procedures and control evidence.
  • Complete routine operational checks and scheduled control activities, escalating risks, exceptions or control failures promptly.
  • Support audits, reviews and compliance activities by providing accurate records and evidence.
  • Handle devices, accounts and information in line with security, privacy and records-management requirements.
  • Support compliance with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 (as amended by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025), including immediately escalating any suspected personal data breach to the Data Protection Lead so that the organisation can meet the 72-hour ICO reporting deadline where applicable.
 
OUTCOME 6: Small projects and improvements are delivered and technology keeps getting better
  • Deliver or support small IT projects, upgrades, application roll-outs and service improvements.
  • Gather requirements, coordinate suppliers, plan user communications, support testing and manage implementation activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, efficiency and the user experience.
  • Keep project actions, risks, decisions, documentation and handover materials up to date.


Success Measures

Success in the role will be assessed through:
 
Service delivery

  • Users receive dependable and responsive first and second-line technical support, with routine and complex issues resolved effectively.
  • Incidents and requests are responded to and resolved within agreed service levels.
  • User satisfaction with IT support is consistently positive.
Accuracy, security and control
  • Incidents, requests, access changes and joiner, mover and leaver activities are completed accurately and on time.
  • 100% of leaver accounts disabled by the end of the last working day; new joiners fully equipped and set up on day one.
  • Operational records, registers and control evidence are complete, current and reliable.
  • Periodic access reviews and asset reconciliations completed on schedule with no significant audit findings.
Change and improvement
  • Changes and small projects are delivered in a controlled way with minimal disruption.
  • Recurring problems are reduced and practical improvements are implemented continuously.
  • Feedback from the Senior IT Manager, colleagues and suppliers on collaboration, communication and ownership.


Technical Expertise & Role-Specific Capability

Essential

  • Strong hands-on experience providing both first and second-line IT support within a modern workplace environment, with particular strength in diagnosing and resolving more complex technical issues.
  • Demonstrable experience managing a broad range of incidents and service requests through their full lifecycle, from initial user contact to resolution.
  • Practical experience of joiner, mover and leaver processes, identity administration, permissions and access control.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 and supporting Windows devices, laptops, mobile devices and common business applications.
  • Experience maintaining IT asset records, operational registers, procedures and control evidence.
  • Understanding of proportionate change management, information security and data protection practices.
  • Ability to troubleshoot methodically, make sound decisions and know when to engage specialist support.
  • Experience coordinating external IT suppliers and seeing actions through to completion.
  • Ability to organise a varied workload independently and balance urgent support needs with planned operational work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical matters to non-technical users.
  • Experience contributing to or delivering small IT projects and technology changes.
 
Desirable
  • Experience in a small organisation where the role covers a broad range of operational IT responsibilities.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Autopilot, SharePoint and Teams administration.
  • Experience with IT service management tools and ITIL-aligned working practices.
  • Experience supporting SaaS applications and coordinating managed service, cyber security or other specialist partners.
  • Relevant technical or service management certification (e.g. Microsoft 365 / Azure certifications, ITIL Foundation), or equivalent practical experience.


Career Framework Expectations

Our Career Framework provides a shared approach to development and performance across the organisation. It is built around four core pillars: Connect, Deliver, Focus and Lead, which outline the key behaviours and expectations expected at all levels.
In this role, the pillars look like this:

CONNECT — Building trust, relationships and collaboration

  • Collaborative and able to build effective relationships with users, colleagues and suppliers.
  • Technically credible, user-focused and committed to providing a high-quality service.
DELIVER — Driving outcomes and execution
  • Proactive and self-sufficient, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Calm and organised when handling competing priorities or service disruption.
FOCUS — Applying expertise and driving improvement
  • Detail-oriented and disciplined about keeping records, documentation and actions up to date.
  • Curious and improvement-minded, with a willingness to learn and adapt.
LEAD — Leading self, others and organisational success
  • Practical and proportionate, applying appropriate control without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Role-models secure and responsible use of technology and shares knowledge so colleagues become more self-sufficient.


Organisational Values

  1. We are change makers: keeps the technology behind FAIRR’s work dependable, so colleagues can spend their time on the mission rather than on IT problems.
  2. We collaborate: works closely with HR, managers, colleagues and suppliers to deliver a joined-up service.
  3. We innovate: looks for better, simpler and more secure ways of working, and delivers improvements that last.
  4. We act with integrity: handles privileged access, devices and personal data responsibly, confidentially and transparently.


Additional Information

Working Arrangements
Hybrid working from near Marble Arch (Oxford Street), London, UK, in line with FAIRR’s organisational working arrangements.
 
Normal working hours are 9.00am–5.30pm, Monday to Friday. Because much of the role is hands-on (devices, meeting-room technology, joiner set-up), the postholder will be expected to work on site at least 3 days per week and on key operational days such as new starter inductions.
 
Occasional work outside normal hours may be required for planned changes or urgent incidents. This will be agreed in advance wherever possible and recognised through time off in lieu in line with FAIRR policy.

Travel Requirements
Occasional travel within London and the UK may be required (e.g. supplier visits, training or events). International travel is not an expected part of the role.

Salary Range
To be confirmed during recruitment stage.

Benefits
Benefits will be provided in line with FAIRR’s standard employee benefits package.

Pre-Employment Checks
Appointment is subject to proof of the right to work in the UK, satisfactory references and, because the role holds privileged system access, a Basic DBS criminal record check. Information will be handled in line with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and data protection law.
 
Equal Opportunities & Reasonable Adjustments
FAIRR welcomes applications from all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process or in the role, please let us know.

Performance & Flexibility

  • This JD forms the basis for performance reviews.
  • Performance against this JD will be reviewed during the 5-month probationary period and in regular one-to-ones thereafter.
  • This job description is not exhaustive or contractual. The organisation reserves the right to modify duties and responsibilities to reflect organisational needs, subject to consultation where appropriate.

🍊Our mission

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe.

We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027.

🍊About the role

We are looking for a software engineer to help build the platform powering the next generation of clinical trials. Join our fast-moving team and help us scale the product to manage complex trials and bring new treatments to patients faster!

This is an onsite role in London with a flexible (hybrid) office arrangement. After an initial onboarding period full-time at our headquarters (near London Bridge) we expect you to be in the office at least 3 days a week.

We’d like to hear from you if…

  • You have 3+ years experience as a professional software engineer collaborating within a team

  • You are product-minded: you want to understand why we are building something to figure out the best how in collaboration with product managers, designers, non-technical colleagues and users

  • You have embraced the recent advances in AI, and enjoy leveraging AI to help you in your role

  • You are comfortable working across a stack that includes frontend (TypeScript/React), backend (Python/Node.js/Postgres) and infrastructure (AWS). You don’t necessarily have hands-on experience with all pieces of our stack but are happy to pick up technology and processes that’s new to you.

  • You have supported systems at scale in production.

  • You can work independently but also collaborate well with others.

  • You are passionate and curious about our mission; changing how the clinical trials industry operates and how new medicines are developed.

  • You want to learn what life is like at a high-growth, mission-driven VC funded startup

You belong here! If your experience and interests match those above, we want you to apply.

    • Develop deeper understanding of one or more areas of our stack

    • Contribute actively to the team’s processes and rituals, such as retrospectives and standups

  • Within your first 6 months

    • Get close to users, observe the product being used in real trials and support the team in responding to feature requests and bug reports

    • Take on more complex coding and design tasks

    • Rotate through our support function, handling user issues and investigating and fixing bugs

    • Deepen your understanding of clinical trials, and build relationships across the wider company

🍊 What we offer

Make an impact across all areas of our business and fix one of the world's most broken industries.

  • Competitive salary, plus meaningful stock options

  • Flexible working: We have an incredible office near London Bridge and encourage people to work 3 days per week from the office

  • 30 days annual leave in addition to Bank Holidays, resulting in 39 paid days off per year

  • £60 monthly wellness allowance, which you can spend on our company health insurance scheme through AXA, a wellhub membership, or wellness activities and expenses of your choice!

  • £1,000 Learning and Development allowance each year to put towards courses, certifications, and development

  • Regular whole company and team events, both in person and virtually

  • Access to gym and retail discounts through our benefits platform Happl

  • A well-stocked pantry and drinks fridge, Monday breakfast spread and catered team lunch on a Thursday for the UK office every week!

  • Cycle-to-work scheme and other salary sacrifice options available

  • Charity events and fundraising opportunities through our charity partnership with the Forward Trust

🍊 Our Hiring Process

We believe hiring should be transparent, respectful of your time, and give you a real feel for what Lindus Health is like. Here's what to expect:

Get to know each other, discuss the role, and answer any questions you have

This will be a coding task, which you can complete in Python or TypeScript, that is reviewed by a member of the engineering team.

Deep dive into your experience and how you'd approach key challenges

About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.

  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight.

jobs.title: Clinical Data & Quality Manager
jobs.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Your impact

You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself.

Your day-to-day work

  • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems.

  • Manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and inspection preparation, beyond data cleaning alone.

  • Qualify systems using CSV/CSQ approaches and apply ALCOA+ principles.

  • Work with EDC systems and ePRO/eCOA solutions, translating their requirements into practical controls.

  • Communicate and write fluently in English.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A rigorous approach that takes operational constraints into account.

  • Practical judgement to turn requirements into workable processes.

  • The ability to influence and train colleagues rather than impose rules.

  • Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO.

  • Handled clinical quality topics such as deviations, audits, inspections or procedures.

  • Contributed to computerised system qualification.

  • Worked with EDC systems, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva or Oracle, and ePRO/eCOA solutions.

It’s a plus if you

  • Understand pipelines, ETL and databases, without needing to be a developer.

  • Know CDISC standards for regulatory submissions.

  • Want to move from data production to compliance oversight and help build quality practices.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to reliable studies and data that support clinical research in oncology.

  • Combine clinical quality, data integrity and collaboration with technical teams.

  • Work remotely from France and meet colleagues at internal company events.

The charm of a diplomat, the curiosity of an investigator, the network of a secret agent – that's how we described this role internally.

It sounds exaggerated, but it's remarkably accurate: at ICS International Carrier Services, we work at the intersection of law enforcement agencies and telecommunications providers – lawful interception, a highly sensitive field where trust is the real currency.

And this market is moving: we are internationalizing rapidly, new communication services such as satellite connectivity are opening entirely new fields, and enquiries are growing faster than our calendars.

That's why we're looking for you – not to fill a position, but to build the commercial side of a fast-growing player that is seizing its international opportunities right now. We are a highly motivated team that wants to achieve something big together – and that's exactly the energy we expect from you.

Why ICS

  • Globally connected: We operate at the forefront of lawful interception in a global market – and are deeply networked across the LI world
  • Own technology, approved by authorities: Our proprietary software stack makes us extremely fast, remarkably adaptable and highly competitive on pricing – and it has been audited and approved multiple times by the German Federal Network Agency (BNetzA) and other international authorities
  • Shaping the standards: We contribute to the global standards of our industry in the ETSI working groups
  • Profitable and growing: We are profitable and growing strongly – the ongoing internationalization is your growth opportunity
  • Experienced team: A top engineering team and a management with over 20 years of telco experience
  • Insider knowledge: A market largely hidden from the public: outsiders don't know it, and much of the information – especially on the law enforcement side – simply isn't public. Being on the inside is an advantage you can't google

Tasks

You build our business development – as Head of, initially without a team, working directly with the managing directors. One thing upfront: this is not a classic sales role – it's B2B relationship work, winning new customers through trust rather than cold outreach.

  • Industry presence: You represent us at industry events, trade fairs and association meetings – nationally and internationally. You are where the industry is
  • Relationships with network operators: You build and maintain long-term relationships with telcos, mobile and fixed-line operators, MVNOs, ISPs and carriers – key account and partner management at its best
  • Spotting opportunities: You watch the market and spot opportunities long before they become concrete projects – and open the doors to them
  • Building the strategy: You develop our business development strategy and the processes behind it from scratch
  • Opening conversations: You lead initial conversations and drive opportunities through to handover to the managing directors

Requirements

We care less about your CV – we care about how you connect with people. No technical background required – our topics are highly technical, but we can teach the details. Curiosity and a quick mind, however, can't be taught.

And you don't need to have done this role for years: it doesn't exist at ICS yet, and it can grow with you. What you do need is the desire to do it – and the courage to approach people you don't know yet.

  • You genuinely love people. Not as a phrase, but for real: building and nurturing relationships isn't a job for you, it's your nature
  • Networking is your strength: you never wait to be approached at an event – and after one evening you've made more valuable contacts than others do in an entire trade-fair week
  • C-level communication is not a bonus skill for you – it's part of the game: you engage as a peer with CEOs, managing directors and decision-makers at telcos, ISPs and carriers – as well as at industry associations and events
  • You are outgoing without being artificial: open, authentic, trustworthy
  • Drive: You are highly motivated and want to build something big with us – going through the motions isn't how we work, in either direction
  • Languages: You communicate at full professional proficiency in German and English
  • Entrepreneurial: You work independently, think entrepreneurially and want to build something, not administer it

Helpful but not a must: experience in business development, key account management or partner management – or a background in regulation, association work, consulting or the public-authority sector.

A real plus: an existing network among telcos, ISPs, MVNOs and carriers – ideally international. Nice to have: contacts with law enforcement and security agencies internationally – the agency side is becoming a growing field for us as well.

Absolute reliability and discretion are a given – even when an authority takes a closer look.

Benefits

  • On-target earnings up to €150,000: €70,000–90,000 base salary plus variable compensation (€60,000 at 100% target achievement – uncapped, overachievement keeps paying)
  • Real ownership: you build a function from zero – with a direct line to the managing directors, no corporate hierarchy
  • International events and travel: you're out where the industry meets

  • Team: A small, highly motivated team with short decision paths that wants to achieve something big together
  • Stories to tell: A work environment you can tell stories about at your next dinner party (at least the parts you're allowed to share)

Sound like you? Then let's talk. No cover letter needed – send us your CV and two or three sentences on why this role appeals to you. Or even better: tell us about a contact you made when it seemed impossible. If there's a general fit, we'll start with a confidential conversation.
