Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
About AQEMIA
 
AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.
 
For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn. 
 
About our Team
 
AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.
 
This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.

The role

AQEMIA's drug discovery programs and AI platform increasingly create value through licensing deals and strategic partnerships with pharma and biotech companies.

As our first in-house Legal Counsel, you will lead the legal work on these deals from term sheet to signing. You'll make sure each licensing agreement maximises value creation for Aqemia, protects our IP, and the platform behind every program. Beyond licensing, you will become the trusted legal partner for CEO, founders, leadership and teams across the company, covering IP and patents, operational contracts, data and AI, compliance and corporate matters alongside specialist external counsel. Within a year, you will have shaped how legal works at AQEMIA: issues will be mapped and anticipated, processes will be practical, and leadership will rely on you for well-judged legal advice. Reporting to the Corporate Finance Manager, you’ll have a rare chance to sit at the centre of the deals that bring AI-discovered drug candidates to partners, and to grow well beyond licensing into a broad in-house role.


Responsibilities
  • Licensing & partnerships: lead the legal work on licensing and collaboration deals, drafting and negotiating agreements from term sheet to signing.
  • Deal strategy: work with BD, Finance and Leadership to turn commercial goals into contract terms, while protecting AQEMIA's platform and other programs.
  • IP & patents: support IP protection and patent-related decisions with scientific teams and external patent counsel.
  • Operational contracts: draft and negotiate NDAs, MTAs, CRO, vendor, software and data agreements, including contractual questions on data use and AI.
  • Corporate & compliance: adresss GDPR, regulatory, compliance and dispute-related matters with specialist support where needed, and support corporate and fundraising matters in coordination with Finance and external advisors.
  • Legal processes: own templates and approval workflows, highlight key contract obligations and deadlines to relevant teams, and manage external counsel.

    • Qualifications
  • Law degree or equivalent professional legal qualification.
  • 5+ years of legal experience, including time at a law firm in a life sciences practice. In-house experience at a biotech or pharma company is a strong plus.
  • Licensing: hands-on experience drafting and negotiating biotech or pharma licensing agreements yourself, not only coordinating external counsel.
  • Deal knowledge: strong understanding of licensing mechanics and IP ownership in drug discovery (scope, exclusivity, financials, termination).
  • Communication: excellent English drafting and negotiation skills, and you can explain legal points clearly to non-lawyers.
  • Mindset: autonomous, pragmatic and eager to learn legal topics beyond your current expertise.

    • Nice‑to‑Have
  • In-house experience at a biotech, pharma or TechBio company, ideally a startup or lean legal team.
  • Exposure to AI, data or technology platform agreements (data rights, model training, ownership of outputs).
  • Experience building legal processes, templates or contract management from scratch.
  • Business development or commercial experience alongside your legal background.
  • Professional French.

    • Our recruitment process

    • 1 - Hiring Manager’s interview: you’ll meet directly with your future manager (45 mins)
    • 2 - Technical assessment of your skills through a Business Case (60 mins)
    • 3 - Cultural fit interview with our co-founder and COO Emmanuelle (45 mins)
    • 4 - Final interview with our co-founder and CEO Maximilien (45 mins)

jobs.description:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.


Job Overview

Solactive's Aggregate team owns the intraday calculation of our indices: consuming live price streams, applying calculation logic across a wide range of indices, and producing a continuous output stream of index ticks throughout the trading day. The core platform is built in Java and engineered around throughput, latency, and correctness under concurrency, while custom business integrations are built in Python. As a Working Student you join a small team and contribute real, production-bound code to both, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and coach you.


Your Tasks

  • Implement well-scoped features and fixes in the Java calculation platform, such as improvements to calculation components, price stream consumption, or index tick production
  • Write unit, integration, and performance tests, including tests for concurrent code paths where ordering and timing matter
  • Help investigate correctness or performance issues: reproduce them, narrow them down, and propose fixes with senior guidance
  • Build and maintain Python integrations for business teams: connectors to the calculation platform, output adapters, validation checks, and small operational tools
  • Contribute to monitoring and developer tooling that makes calculation behaviour observable and easier to reason about
  • Take part in design and code reviews, ask questions, and document what you learn so the next person can pick it up faster


Your Profile

  • Enrolled student in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field
  • Strong Java fundamentals: object-oriented design, collections, generics, and comfort reading and writing idiomatic modern Java
  • Solid grounding in core computer science: data structures, algorithms, and complexity, and in particular a working understanding of multithreading and concurrency (threads, synchronisation, memory visibility, races and deadlocks)
  • Openness to Python: no prior experience needed, but willingness to pick it up for integration and tooling work alongside Java
  • Familiarity with Git, the command line, and a testing mindset; interest in measuring performance rather than guessing at it
  • Ability to work independently on a scoped task, ask for help early when stuck, and communicate clearly in writing
  • Available for 15–20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks
  • Interest in financial markets, market data, or index calculation is welcome but not required


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family  an international FinTech environment with flat hierarchies, real ownership, and strong growth opportunities.
  • Enjoy attractive benefits such as team events, Corporate Benefits access, a modern ergonomic office,free beverages and fruit.
  • Work on a real, high-impact production platform and contribute to architectural improvements not just feature tickets.
  • Gain hands-on experience with Java microservices, build systems, and dependency governance while collaborating with experienced engineers.
  • Build practical backend engineering skills that directly support your long-term career development.


Your Application

jobs.title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

In this role you own all of finance at Superchat end to end and report directly to the founders. When the board or our investors have a question about the numbers, you're the one who answers it.
You'll take over our financial model and turn it into something the whole company can steer by. You'll own accounting through to the P&L, run forecasting and liquidity planning, and lead the annual audit.

Who We Want

7+ years of finance experience.
You know the full cycle first-hand, from closing to forecast to board reporting.

Closing and audit expertise.
You independently own monthly and annual closings under HGB, including revenue recognition and accruals, and you coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors through to completed financial statements.

Expert financial modelling.
You build driver-based, integrated three-statement models from scratch and you document them so that others can operate them too.

Forecasting.
You've owned full budget and forecast cycles, you bring together top-down targets and bottom-up input from team leads, and you treat forecast accuracy as a measurable figure that has to improve.

Business partner.
You deliver a reasoned recommendation, not just the numbers and you follow up on whether it gets implemented.

Experience with investors and the board.
You've prepared and presented board materials, and you've been through a financial due diligence - ideally on the company side.
Bridges finance and startup culture. You bring the rigour a finance function demands, while working productively with fast decisions and shifting priorities.

Appetite for automation.
You actively look for ways to take manual work out of the close and the reporting cycle, so the team's time goes into analysis rather than assembly.

Strong communicator.
You translate complex financial data into clear narratives for stakeholders without a finance background, and you're confident in the room with founders, board and investors. Fluent German and English, written and verbal.

Who We Don't Want

Manages the status quo.
You run an inherited function competently, but you don't develop it further.

Reports instead of advising.
You deliver numbers without drawing a recommendation from them, and consider the job done once the report is sent.

Treats the model as personal property.
You build something only you can operate with undocumented logic and manual overrides nobody else can follow. Uncomfortable in front of investors.

Looking for predictability.
You need stable priorities and permanently fixed responsibilities.

Your Day To Day

Financial Model & Steering (~30%)

  • You own and maintain our driver-based financial model documented, operable by others, and reconciled to actuals every month
  • You own forecasting, budgeting, liquidity and runway planning, and the management of cash conversion
  • You own headcount planning together with the founders, People and team leads
  • You evaluate business cases for new products, markets and pricing models, and act as a sparring partner to the founders on strategic decisions

Accounting, Tax & Audit (~30%)

  • You own bookkeeping and monthly, quarterly and annual closings under HGB, with clean revenue recognition and accruals
  • You coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors end to end, through to completed financial statements
  • You manage the relationship with our tax advisors and ensure tax obligations are met
  • You own AR, AP and payment processes, and a cost centre structure that scales with the company

KPIs & Business Partnering (~20%)

  • You define and monitor the metrics each team steers by - engagement, conversion, retention - as inputs to the model rather than a separate reporting exercise
  • You sit in the business reviews, translate numbers into concrete recommendations, and follow up on execution
  • You deliver month-end variance analysis and management reporting as a clear, action-oriented narrative rather than a data dump
  • You analyse revenue, margin and cost development at customer, product and channel level

Funding & Investor Relations (~20%)

  • You build and continuously maintain our data room so we're due-diligence-ready at any time
  • You lead the financial due diligence on our side and support the next funding round end to end
  • You own investor reporting and communication on a monthly and quarterly cadence, as well as the board reporting packages
  • You maintain relationships with investors, banks and financing partners

Stakeholders

Founders & Leadership Team: your most important counterpart day-to-day, from annual planning to ongoing prioritisation and the most consequential financial decisions

Team Leads across Sales, Marketing, Product & Customer Success: for KPI definition, budget ownership and business reviews

Board & Investors: for monthly and quarterly reporting, board meetings and funding rounds

External Partners: tax advisors, auditors, banks and financing partners

Benefits & Culture

jobs.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. VOS MISSIONS

  • Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations.
  • Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants.
  • Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports.
  • Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication.

VOTRE PROFIL

jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Dust is hiring a Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery to make high-impact Dust deployments repeatable at scale.

When customers deploy Dust well, AI agents become part of how their teams work every day. Your job is to make that happen consistently, whether a deployment is led by Dust or by a trusted partner. You will lead our most complex customer deployments, turn what works, technically and organizationally, into clear playbooks, and build the partner delivery capacity that lets more customers succeed with Dust in 2027 and beyond.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You will lead and grow Dust’s global AI Deployment team, stay directly involved in our most important deployments, and build the methods, standards, and partner network that allow delivery to scale without depending on you for every engagement.

You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to connect what customers want to achieve with how deployments are planned, delivered, and measured.

This is a chance to define how an AI-native company delivers transformation: what an exceptional deployment looks like, how value is measured, and how partners become delivery teams our customers trust.

What you’ll do

Lead and grow the global AI Deployment team

  • Lead Dust’s existing global AI Deployment team and set its direction, priorities, and standards.

  • Hire and develop deployment leaders and practitioners as customer demand grows.

  • Shape roles, career paths, and coverage across regions, customer segments, and deployment types.

  • Coach the team through complex customer situations and hold a consistently high bar for the work.

  • Set up the operating rhythms, capacity planning, and reporting the function needs to scale.

Define how Dust deployments are delivered

  • Build one deployment method, from discovery through handoff, that Dust and partner teams can both follow to the same standard.

  • Define which deployments Dust should lead, which a partner can deliver well, and how work moves between the two.

  • Set clear entry and exit criteria and go-live readiness checks, and track delivery health: time to first value, go-live quality, and customer satisfaction.

  • Run regular delivery reviews, spot at-risk engagements early, and bring the right Dust and partner people together quickly when a deployment is blocked.

  • Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable playbooks, templates, and reference architectures, and recurring friction into clear input for Product and Engineering.

Lead AI transformation with strategic customers

  • Personally lead complex, high-priority, and first-of-their-kind deployments, from scoping to lasting adoption, bringing in Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering when complexity or risk calls for it.

  • Help customer leaders define what AI transformation means for their organization: map how teams work today and identify the workflows where agents can create the most value.

  • Align executives, IT, security, and business teams on goals, use cases, and success measures, with a baseline before launch and measured impact after.

  • Design change programs for each deployment: executive sponsorship, communication plans, role-based enablement, and clear adoption milestones.

  • Develop AI operators and champions inside customer teams, and help customers update ways of working, governance, and ownership so agents become part of how teams operate.

  • Track adoption after launch, act quickly when teams aren’t changing how they work, and hand off to Customer Success with a clear picture of what comes next.

Build a high-quality partner delivery network

  • Work with Partnerships to assess partners’ delivery capability, technical depth, and customer readiness.

  • Start with a small, carefully selected group of partner practitioners and grow capacity as quality is proven.

  • Co-create onboarding, training, certification, and train-the-trainer programs so partners can develop their own Dust experts.

  • Co-deliver early partner engagements, then help partners progress toward delivering independently, leading adoption, not just implementation.

  • Ensure customers experience Dust and its partners as one aligned team, with clear responsibilities on every engagement.

Requirements

  • You have at least 6 years of experience leading and developing customer-facing deployment or delivery teams, ideally across multiple regions or customer segments and through periods of fast change.

  • You have led complex enterprise deployments or transformation programs and delivered measurable customer outcomes.

  • You have built or significantly improved a deployment methodology, professional services model, or delivery function, adding the structure needed to scale without unnecessary process.

  • You have led organizational change alongside technology rollouts, and built champion networks or adoption plans that changed how teams work after the project ended.

    You don’t need to be a machine-learning engineer. Beyond that, we care more about evidence that you have built high-performing delivery systems than about a perfect sequence of titles.

  • You understand how systems integrators, consultancies, and implementation partners staff, deliver, and grow a practice, and you have built enablement or certification programs that created lasting capability in teams you didn’t manage.

  • You have turned around engagements at risk from scope, staffing, technical complexity, or stakeholder misalignment, and you know when to standardize, when to adapt, and when to reset.

  • You are credible with customer executives, partner leaders, and technical practitioners, and you communicate clearly with all of them.

  • You are a hands-on, low-ego leader with a builder’s instinct: you would rather solve the problem than hand off a recommendation.

  • You are comfortable traveling to customers and partners when it matters most.

AI and technical credibility

  • Advise customers on where AI agents can create meaningful value and where they can’t yet, and explain why to technical teams, business leaders, and executives.

  • Understand how agents work in practice: prompting, context, tool use, retrieval, evaluations, reliability, and cost.

  • Challenge a deployment plan’s assumptions about integrations, data connectors, authentication, permissions, security, and production readiness, and discuss the trade-offs with engineers.

  • Design evaluation approaches that connect AI performance to customer and business outcomes.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Process (F/H)
jobs.description:
Vous êtes attiré par les industries à forte valeur ajoutée et l’économie circulaire ?

Vous disposez d’une expérience reconnue dans le domaine des process chimiques dans un environnement exigeant ?

Vous voulez accompagner une entreprise volontaire dans son développement et donner du sens à votre mission ?

Venez rejoindre IMET Alloys France !

Nous recherchons un

Ingénieur Process (F/H)

Tulle (19) - Région Nouvelle Aquitaine

 

Nous recherchons un ingénieur des procédés capable d’apporter l’expérience, l’expertise et le dynamisme nécessaires pour faire progresser nos procédés, qu’ils soient nouveaux ou déjà établis, et renforcer notre position de leader mondial dans le domaine du retraitement des résidus à haute valeur ajoutée.

Après une période d’intégration qui vous permettra de bien comprendre nos process, alliant procédés chimiques, mécaniques et automatismes, vous serez chargé de développer, contrôler, surveiller et améliorer en permanence les procédés de fabrication. Vous serez amené à intervenir sur l’ensemble des process de fabrication mais votre mission sera particulièrement orientée vers notre process de nettoyage des alliages.


Rattaché à notre Directeur Process Groupe, basé au Royaume Unis, et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie, d’exploitation, de maintenance, de qualité et commerciales, vous traduirez les exigences des clients et de l’entreprise en procédés de fabrication robustes et reproductibles. Vous rédigez ainsi les process et les standards notamment pour les process spécifiques du site d’Eyrein.

Vous êtes en contact avec nos fournisseurs pour assurer les évolutions ou développement de nos process et en supervisez la mise en œuvre. Vous rédigez les cahiers des charges et les évolutions de process nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs de l’Entreprise.

Au-delà d’une formation de niveau Bac +5, vous disposez avant tout d’une expérience réussie sur un poste similaire au sein d’une industrie d’au moins 3 à 5 ans.

Femme ou homme de terrain, vous êtes reconnu pour votre curiosité, votre capacité à comprendre des process complexes. Vous savez identifier les opportunités et proposer des actions correctives tout en accompagnant le développement de l’activité. Votre sens aigu de l’organisation et votre excellent relationnel, vous permettent d’interagir avec l’ensemble des services techniques de l’entreprise en France comme à l’étranger.

La maitrise de l’anglais tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit est un prérequis pour mener à bien cette mission. Vous faites preuve d’une bonne capacité d’analyse et d’écoute ainsi que d’un bon esprit d’équipe.

Enfin, un fort sens de l’éthique, un esprit d’initiative et une orientation vers les résultats sont déterminants pour la réussite dans ce poste.

 

IMET ALLOYS est une société industrielle à forte valeur ajoutée, filiale d’un groupe international, spécialisée dans la valorisation et la sécurisation des métaux critiques (titane, superalliages) indispensables aux industries de pointe.

Basée à Eyrein, en France, l’entreprise, certifiée ISO 9001 et ISO 14001 est au cœur des enjeux européens de souveraineté industrielle, d’économie circulaire et de décarbonation.

En forte phase de développement, IMET ALLOYS conduit un ambitieux programme d’investissements industriels et structure ses opérations pour accompagner une croissance durable sur des marchés exigeants (aéronautique, médical, énergie).

jobs.title: Techniciens de Maintenance F/H
jobs.description:
Vous êtes un professionnel de la maintenance industrielle ?

Vous êtes attiré par les industries à forte valeur ajoutée et l’économie circulaire ?

Curieux et rigoureux, vous êtes à l’aise dans les interventions mécaniques, électrotechniques, hydraulique…, que vous souhaitez mettre à profit au sein d’une entreprise ambitieuse et volontaire ?

Venez rejoindre IMET Alloys France !

Nous recherchons des

Techniciens de Maintenance F/H

Tulle (19) - Région Nouvelle Aquitaine

 

Dans le cadre de la forte augmentation des volumes de production, IMET Alloys fait évoluer son organisation et installe des équipes de « soir et nuit » et de week-end. Ainsi, nous recherchons des Techniciens de Maintenance F/H capables d’apporter leur expérience.

Après une période d’intégration qui vous permettra de bien comprendre nos process, vous serez chargé d’assurer la disponibilité, la fiabilité et la performance de nos équipements de production. Vous intervenez tant sur les actions préventives que correctives.

Vous diagnostiquez les pannes, effectuez les réparations dans le respect des règles de sécurité pour remettre les équipements dans une situation de fonctionnement optimal. Vous minimisez les temps d’arrêts pour que les opérateurs de production puissent atteindre les objectifs.

Garant du suivi des procédures de maintenance, vous documentez vos interventions dans notre système de GMAO. Vous testez et validez le bon fonctionnement des équipements après interventions. Vous pilotez les stocks de pièces détachées et alertez en cas de besoin de réapprovisionnement. Vous pilotez les interventions de nos sous-traitants sur les opérations de maintenances spécifiques.

Vous pouvez être amené à intervenir avec les équipes process sur des sujets d’amélioration continue de nos équipements de production. Vous proposez des solutions pour l’optimisation de la fiabilité et de la performance des machines.


Issu d’une formation technique en Maintenance Industrielle, en Mécanique et Productique ou encore en Electronique ou équivalent, vous disposez avant tout d’une expérience réussie sur un poste en maintenance au sein d’une industrie d’au moins 3/5 ans.

Femme ou homme de terrain, vous êtes reconnu pour votre curiosité, votre capacité à comprendre les équipements de production et êtes capable d’intervenir sur des sujets mécaniques, électrotechniques, hydrauliques et pneumatiques. Une connaissance des systèmes de contrôle Siemens et Allen Bradley et une habilitation électrique (BR/BC) seraient des plus.

Enfin, un fort sens de l’éthique, un esprit d’initiative et une orientation vers les résultats sont déterminants pour la réussite dans ce poste.

 

IMET ALLOYS est une société industrielle à forte valeur ajoutée, filiale d’un groupe international, spécialisée dans la valorisation et la sécurisation des métaux critiques (titane, superalliages) indispensables aux industries de pointe.

Basée à Eyrein, en France, notre site de production dispose d’équipements de dernière génération, tous installés neufs ces 5 dernières années. Nous sommes au cœur des enjeux européens de souveraineté industrielle, d’économie circulaire et de décarbonation.

En forte phase de développement, IMET ALLOYS conduit un ambitieux programme d’investissements industriels et structure ses opérations pour accompagner une croissance durable sur des marchés exigeants (aéronautique, médical, énergie).
